jobs.title: Director
jobs.reason: This is a Director role with ultimate executive responsibility, leading a senior team of three Deputy Directors — far beyond entry-level and requiring extensive senior leadership experience the candidate does not have. The subject matter is of clear interest, but the level is a hard mismatch.

jobs.title: Policy Fellow or Senior Policy Fellow, US Development Policy Program
jobs.reason: Location is a hard filter (London only) and this role is based in Washington DC with no London or remote-UK option. It is also a Fellow / Senior Fellow level requiring substantial experience, and the development-policy topic is outside the candidate's core interest zones.

jobs.title: Fellow, Climate policy & development
jobs.reason: A "Fellow" role at CGD is a senior research position requiring substantial post-qualification experience and an established record, which the candidate (student-assistant / RA background only) does not have. Climate and development policy also falls outside the candidate's core interest zones.

jobs.title: Associate or Senior Editor, Nature Genetics
jobs.reason: The role's essential requirement is a PhD in cancer research/oncology or biomedical research — an already-completed doctorate the candidate does not hold — which is a hard disqualifier. It is also entirely outside the candidate's field (genetics/genomics editing) and skill set.
jobs.location: Shanghai, Beijing, Madrid, Milan or Pune (Hybrid)

jobs.title: Food Safety Auditors - (Global)
jobs.reason: The role requires demonstrated experience delivering food-safety audits plus appropriate professional qualifications and sector experience (retail, hospitality, seafood, agriculture) — essentials the candidate does not hold. It sits entirely outside all interest zones and is a poor paper fit.

jobs.title: Adjunct Professor (LA.06.3)
jobs.reason: Multiple hard disqualifiers: requires enrolment as a practising Attorney of the High Court (legal qualification/admission the candidate lacks), a PhD, and at least ten years' post-admission experience — a senior professorial role. The candidate meets none of these essentials.

jobs.title: Senior Software Developer
jobs.reason: Senior title requiring several years of Kotlin/Java software-engineering experience, plus mentoring of junior developers — a deep-technical role well beyond the candidate's analysis-level skills and lacking any professional software engineering experience. It fails both the seniority and technical-skills disqualifiers, and is entirely outside the candidate's interest zones.

jobs.title: Development Consultant - Salesforce
jobs.reason: This is a deep-technical Salesforce development role requiring 3-5 years of hands-on programming (Apex, LWC, Visualforce) that far exceeds the candidate's analysis-level Python and would disqualify on both the software-engineering skills gap and the 3+ years of experience. It has no connection to the candidate's research, policy or intelligence interests.
